approved.en: Russia is intensifying air and missile strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, targeting power facilities, the Northern Bridge, and emergency crews, while Ukrainian forces are hitting Russian missile launchers, air-defence systems in Bryansk Oblast and the Saratov oil refinery. Iran has delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pursues a gas pipeline deal, and Azerbaijan and Ukraine have signed new energy-defence and trade agreements, with Zelensky urging Latin America to help rebuild Ukraine's power grid. Europe will join US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, and space is becoming a critical domain in the war. 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland intensiverer luft‑ og missilangrep mot ukrainsk infrastruktur, og rammer kraftverk, den nordlige broen og redningsmannskaper, mens ukrainske styrker treffer russiske missilutskytere og luftvernsystemer i Bryansk-oblast samt Saratov-oljeraffineriet. Iran har levert en hemmelig Khamenei-melding til Putin mens Moskva forfølger en gassrørledningsavtale, og Aserbajdsjan og Ukraina har signert nye energi-forsvars‑ og handelsavtaler, med Zelensky som oppfordrer Latin-Amerika til å hjelpe med å gjenoppbygge Ukrainas strømnett. Europa vil delta i US-medierte forhandlinger i Abu Dhabi, og rommet blir en kritisk arena i krigen. 75 767 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A sand embankment collapsed in Gaza, killing a woman and injuring several people. Israeli forces deported fourteen foreign pro-Palestinian activists arrested in the West Bank during the olive harvest and seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens of residents. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israel has expanded its footprint in southern Lebanon by constructing a 90km network of military roads, including one in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, and establishing new bases. Hezbollah has continued artillery fire on Israeli positions and begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. Israeli strikes have wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65-year-old retired engineer. Protests against Israeli attacks on Palestine and Lebanon occurred in Sweden. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and there were 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hizbollah har fortsatt artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og begynt å utbetale kontanter til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. Israelske angrep har såret en libanesisk fotballspiller og ført til fengsling av en 65‑år gammel pensjonert ingeniør. Protester mot israelske angrep på Palestina og Libanon fant sted i Sverige. approved.en: Iran launched a missile that struck a building in Tel Aviv while the United States carried out fresh strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island and disabled a commercial vessel attempting to run a blockade in the Gulf of Oman. The IRGC announced that its self-imposed limit on ballistic-missile range has been lifted and that it is building underground sites for weapons production and storage. Tehran delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes a gas-pipeline deal and sent a nuclear proposal to the United States via Qatar. Houthis damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh, and 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

IRGC kunngjorde at den selvpålagte grensen for ballistiske missilers rekkevidde er opphevet og at de bygger underjordiske anlegg for våpenproduksjon og lagring. Houthiene skadet Saudi Aramco-tårnet i Riyadh, og 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have maintained a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. In Riyadh, Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in the financial district and the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina. A Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children, and a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital killed 22 people. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Houthi-styrkene har opprettholdt en månedslang beleiring av Taiz mens jemenittiske regjeringsstyrker har erobret al-Jawf-fjellkjeden, noe som har økt kampene på fronten. I Riyadh har houthi-raketter skadet Saudi Aramco-tårnet i finansdistriktet, og den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen har avskjært en houthi-kryssmissil, en langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil og har skutt ned en ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina. Et saudisk angrep nær Sanaa drepte 22 sivile, hovedsakelig kvinner og barn, og et houthi-påstått luftangrep nær hovedstaden drepte 22 personer. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Syrian forces are reported to be moving troops and advisers toward the Saudi Arabia-Yemen border, while Saudi Arabia is hosting 600 Syrian forces amid fighting with the Houthis. A Syrian sailor was killed while smuggling to the Houthis in Yemen, and a Syrian pharmaceutical tycoon was kidnapped in broad daylight in Aleppo. Israeli violations in southern Syria sparked protests, and anti-Druze hate messages have doubled after elections, spread by pro-government accounts. Syrian forces entered the Roj camp ahead of foreign repatriations, and clashes between two families in Aleppo caused deaths and injuries. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En syrisk sjømann ble drept mens han smuglet til houthiene i Jemen, og en syrisk farmasøytisk milliardær ble kidnappet i fullt dagslys i Aleppo. Israelske overtredelser i sørlige Syria utløste protester, og hatmeldinger mot drusere har doblet seg etter valgene, spredt av pro-regjeringskontoer. Syriske styrker gikk inn i Roj-leiren før utenlandske repatrieringer, og sammenstøt mellom to familier i Aleppo førte til dødsfall og skadde. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iranian-linked drones have repeatedly struck the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, halting production and cutting about 2.8 GW of power, while the attacks have also disrupted electricity supplies in northern Iraq. Iraqi officials have asked Iran to close most border crossings and the foreign minister is negotiating militia weapons regulation with Tehran. Flooding in Erbil and Kirkuk has caused deaths and missing persons, protests have blocked the Mosul-Erbil road in the Nineveh Plains, and a smuggling attempt of petroleum products was foiled in Diyala and Nineveh. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Iransk-tilknyttede droner har gjentatte ganger angrepet gassfeltet Khor Mor i irakisk Kurdistan, stoppet produksjonen og kuttet omtrent 2.8 GW med kraft, mens angrepene også har forstyrret strømforsyningen i Nord-Irak. Iraks tjenestemenn har bedt Iran om å stenge de fleste grenseovergangene, og utenriksministeren forhandler om regulering av militsvåpen med Teheran. Flom i Erbil og Kirkuk har ført til dødsfall og savnede personer, protester har blokkert Mosul-Erbil-veien på Nineveh-sletten, og et forsøk på smugling av petroleumsprodukter ble avverget i Diyala og Nineveh. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

It has arrested a former Bashir-era official and former ruling party head Ahmed Haroun, who was detained after a podcast appearance. Ethiopian fighters are being recruited into the Sudanese army and Tigrayan fighters have been drawn into the conflict, expanding the pool of combatants. The war caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Etiopiske soldater blir rekruttert inn i den sudanske hæren og tigrayanske krigere har blitt trukket inn i konflikten, noe som utvider rekruttbasen. approved.en: Violent incidents continue across South Sudan, including a grenade explosion in Northern Bahr el Ghazal that killed four children and injured two, and the killing of an Ugandan driver in Juba that prompted transporters to demand compensation and the government to be urged to pay the victim's family. The government sent 25 young professionals to Brazil for specialized farming training and President Salva Kiir traveled to Ethiopia, while UNHCR and South Sudan officials held talks to improve support for refugees in Egypt. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Regjeringen sendte 25 unge fagfolk til Brasil for spesialisert jordbrukstrening, og president Salva Kiir reiste til Etiopia, mens UNHCR og sør-sudanske tjenestemenn holdt samtaler om å forbedre støtten til flyktninger i Egypt. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian drones are now operating in Sudan while RSF drones launch from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting reciprocal diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. In northern Ethiopia, an RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed dozens of Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, leading Inspector General Douglas Kanja to deploy additional police and hold security talks. The conflict has displaced over 50,000 Ethiopians who have registered as refugees in Kenya and attacks on Orthodox Christians continue in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, with blasts heard in Addis Ababa. Seed insecurity threatens Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Etiopiske droner opererer nå i Sudan mens RSF-militsen lanserer droner fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål, noe som har ført til gjensidige diplomatiske utvisninger og konsulære nedleggelser. I Nord-Etiopia drepte en RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale dusinvis av etiopiske ortodokse troende og en kenyaner, noe som førte til at inspektørgeneralen Douglas Kanja sendte inn ekstra politi og holdt sikkerhetsmøter. Konflikten har fordrevet over 50 000 etiopiere som har registrert seg som flyktninger i Kenya, og angrep på ortodokse kristne fortsetter i Arsi, Benishangul-Gumuz og i nord, med eksplosjoner hørt i Addis Abeba. Sikkerhetsmangel truer bønder i Tigray, og et pilotprosjekt for psykososial og åndelig omsorg blir testet. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Supreme Court rejected President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's term extension, prompting armed forces to seize the court and threaten the chief. Somali security forces opened fire on protesters in Mogadishu, killing at least three civilians in clashes over home demolitions and two in separate police shootings, while government troops were attacked near Leego town and al-Shabaab fighters left soldiers unburied after a deadly clash. The Somali police deputy chief warned of a security vacuum as Ugandan troops withdraw, and Egypt, Somalia and Djibouti held talks on Red Sea security and Horn of Africa stability. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den somaliske politiets nestleder advarte om et sikkerhetsvakuum når ugandiske tropper trekker seg tilbake, og Egypt, Somalia og Djibouti holdt samtaler om sikkerhet i Rødehavet og stabilitet i Afrikas horn. approved.en: IS-linked militants attacked an Ebola clinic in eastern DR Congo, forcing patients to flee and killing dozens of civilians, while ADF fighters assaulted villages in North Kivu, killing 33 residents. The United Nations peacekeeping mission is set to leave the country in December, and the United States has sanctioned Rwanda’s defence ministry and its military bank Zigama. Joseph Kabila now heads a rebel coalition that includes M23, which has taken positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting with government troops. 1,158 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

FN-fredsbevaringsmisjonen skal forlate landet i desember, og USA har sanksjonert Rwandas forsvarsdepartement og den militære banken Zigama. Joseph Kabila leder nå en opprørskoalisjon som inkluderer M23‑opprørerne, som har tatt posisjoner i Rugezi etter en ukes kamper med regjeringsstyrker. 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The junta bombed a health centre in Thailand's Tak province and struck Karen positions in Mae Hong Son, claiming resistance fire from Thailand, while resistance forces used drones to attack a Christian Bible school, killing three female students. An airstrike on a residence in Mrauk-U killed a pregnant woman and injured ten civilians, and the military is proceeding with April parliamentary by-elections in conflict-hit Sagaing, Chin and Shan, expanding voting to areas of ongoing fighting. The Tatmadaw delegation returned from Laos and a Myanmar delegation participated in the HADR‑2026 disaster-relief exercise, and dead Starlink terminals are being repurposed to locate and kill people. The UCDP recorded 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Et luftangrep på en bolig i Mrauk-U drepte en gravid kvinne og såret ti sivile, og militæret fortsetter med parlamentsvalg i april i konfliktområdene Sagaing, Chin og Shan, og utvider stemmegivningen til områder med pågående kamper. Tatmadaw-delegasjonen kom tilbake fra Laos og en myanmar-delegasjon deltok i HADR‑2026‑katastrofeøvelsen, og døde Starlink-terminaler blir omgjort for å lokalisere og drepe folk. A Polish drug kingpin was arrested in Ecuador for a cross-border cocaine ring, and a major Ecuadorian cocaine and weapons trafficking network was busted in New York. Amerikanske påtalemyndigheter har siktet sønnen til den tidligere presidenten og fire andre for kokainhandel, og knytter ecuadorianske aktører til internasjonale narkoruter. En polsk narkokonge ble arrestert i Ecuador for et grenseoverskridende kokainnettverk, og et stort ecuadoriansk nettverk for kokain‑ og våpenhandel ble slått ned i New York. Det amerikanske militæret bistår Ecuador i sin første landoperasjon mot karteller, og et jordskjelv på styrke 4.7 rammet utenfor Ecuador uten tsunamialarm. Konflikten registrerte to kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2019, ifølge UCDP.
